meta.name: story-short-scan
meta.description: 短篇网文扫榜。分析知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台热门短篇数据，捕捉风口题材。触发方式：/story-short-scan、/短篇扫榜、「短篇什么火」「知乎故事排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫遍热门平台，掌握短篇网文爆款题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是短篇网文作者，想快速知道最近什么题材受欢迎
copy.tagline_en: Scan top platforms to spot viral short-story topics.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write short fiction and need to know what's trending.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 变成短篇网文市场分析师：扫描知乎盐言、七猫、黑岩、点众等平台榜单数据，产出标注样本日期的扫榜报告，含情绪排行、题材热点、风口预警和可写的方向。
howto.when: 当你输入 /短篇扫榜、/story-short-scan，或问「短篇什么火」等短篇榜单问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫一下知乎盐言的短篇榜单，看现在什么题材火
say.note: 它会先问你平台和类型方向

say.text: 扫黑岩短篇男频，给我情绪热度和风口预警
say.note: 需先在 Chrome 里手动登录黑岩

say.text: 扫点众女频短篇，出一份扫榜报告
say.note: 报告会标注样本日期和复扫时间

howto.what_en: Claude becomes a short-story market analyst: it scans platform charts (Zhihu Yanyan, Qimao, Heiyan, Dianzhong and more) and outputs a dated scan report with emotion rankings, trending tropes, saturation alerts and writable directions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type /story-short-scan or /短篇扫榜, or ask what short stories are trending, such as “短篇什么火”.

say_en.text: Scan the Zhihu Yanyan short-story charts and tell me what's hot
say_en.note: It first asks your platform and genre

say_en.text: Scan Heiyan male-channel shorts for emotion heat and saturation alerts
say_en.note: Log into Heiyan in Chrome first

say_en.text: Scan Dianzhong female-channel shorts and give me a scan report
say_en.note: The report is dated and offers directions
